g.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Share of an injected real solar farm's output that each fit finds (1 is all of it; farm injected at 50% of the Primary's pinned capacity, read at season-year 2024, as the ratio of 99th percentiles of output over daylight half-hours). Dot: median over the five injected farms. Line: 80% interval from resampling whole months. Pooled: median over D5, D10, D11, D14, and D16; D9 is shown beside them. Fits use rows before 2026-07-01.'

text.tspan: Share of an injected real solar farm's output that each fit finds (1 is all of it; farm injected at 50% of the Primary's
pinned capacity, read at season-year 2024, as the ratio of 99th percentiles of output over daylight half-hours). Dot: median
over the five injected farms. Line: 80% interval from resampling whole months. Pooled: median over D5, D10, D11, D14, and
D16; D9 is shown beside them. Fits use rows before 2026-07-01.
